---
title: "Wiki"
description: "Evidence for the discretionary adjustments process of the minimal rating process."
---

The wiki collects evidence from official surveillance reports, forecasts, and economic surveys that helps you challenge, corroborate, or fill in the parameters of the [rating app](../app/index.qmd) for your country. It reports what each source states, with a link to the document and page, and leaves it to your country team to judge what that implies for a parameter.

## [Countries](countries/index.qmd)

One dossier per country, with the evidence organized by the assessment areas of the DAP (Economic, Fiscal, Debt, Institutions), the DAP tasks and red flags, key figures, and national institutions.

[Austria](countries/austria.qmd) · [Belgium](countries/belgium.qmd) · [Bulgaria](countries/bulgaria.qmd) · [Croatia](countries/croatia.qmd) · [Cyprus](countries/cyprus.qmd) · [Estonia](countries/estonia.qmd) · [Finland](countries/finland.qmd) · [France](countries/france.qmd) · [Germany](countries/germany.qmd) · [Greece](countries/greece.qmd) · [Hungary](countries/hungary.qmd) · [Ireland](countries/ireland.qmd) · [Italy](countries/italy.qmd) · [Latvia](countries/latvia.qmd) · [Lithuania](countries/lithuania.qmd) · [Luxembourg](countries/luxembourg.qmd) · [Malta](countries/malta.qmd) · [Netherlands](countries/netherlands.qmd) · [Portugal](countries/portugal.qmd) · [Slovakia](countries/slovakia.qmd) · [Slovenia](countries/slovenia.qmd) · [Spain](countries/spain.qmd) · [Sweden](countries/sweden.qmd)
